string.text: So, what exactly are you guarding over here?
This is Duty territory - our base. We don't let random people waltz in here, so remember that!
That's how it is around here - those are our rules.

Oh, so that ghoul sent you? Strange - he looks like a serious guy, but he's running errands for all sorts of scum. 
 
Fine, walk along the fence, and when you get to the stream, you'll see a small building. That's where you'll find that stupid eye - I wouldn't take that thing even if you paid me. 
 
And say hi to Phil for me. We'll be seeing him again...
